recipes.name: Clementine Cake inspired by The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
instructions: For the Candied Clementines
Start by slicing clementines for candying. Make sure you slice them very thin. - clementines
Poach the clementines in boiling water for 1 minute, and then shock them by transferring them to a bowl of ice water. - clementines

Combine sugar and water in a large saucepan. Add a little squeeze of clementine juice and bring to a sweet gentle simmer. Add clementines in a single layer and simmer for 90 minutes, flipping every 30 minutes. - 3 cups of sugar - 1 ½ cups water - clementines
Once soft and translucent, cool on a wire rack and pour clementine syrup into a measuring cup for later. Set aside.
For the Cake
Weigh out cake flour to which you’re going to add salt, baking powder, and baking soda. Whisk to combine. - 450 g of cake flour - 1 ½ tsp salt - ¾ tsp of baking powder - ¾ tsp baking soda
In the bowl of a stand mixer, mix butter until creamy - 1 ½ cup of butter
Scrape down the sides of the bowl and add sugar and mix that as well. - 487 ½ g of sugar
Scrape down the sides again, and add large eggs and vanilla extract. Mix again. - 6 large eggs - 3 tsp vanilla extract
Add clementine juice and clementine zest and mix to combine. - ¾ cup clementine juice - 4 clementines zested
Finally add the dry ingredients and buttermilk and mix just enough to combine. - 450 g of cake flour - 1 ½ tsp salt - ¾ tsp of baking powder - ¾ tsp baking soda - 1 ¼ cup buttermilk
Coat a cake pan with nonstick spray and parchment paper. Add the cake batter and cook at 350°F for 45 minutes. - For the Cake
For the Clementine Glaze

While the cake is baking, make the clementine glaze. Combine sifted powdered sugar, clementine juice, and the clementine zest. Whisk to combine. (You can use milk instead of juice to look more accurate to the movie, but the juice is better). Set aside. - 150 g sifted powdered sugar - 37 ½ ml of clementine juice - 1 clementine zested
For the Assembly
Use a cake tester or a knife to make sure the cake is completely done. - For the Cake
Generously brush down the cake with clementine syrup. - For the Cake - candied clementine syrup
Pour glaze over the top and add candied clementines. - For the Cake - For the Clementine Glaze - For the Candied Clementines
Slice yourself a piece and enjoy.
